verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents that once Habits, Tasks, Focus Time, buffers, Calendar Sync and priorities are configured, it automatically schedules and reschedules events in the background without manual reshuffling, keeps synced copies updated, and syncs Slack status (reclaim-docs-34, -29, -33, -18, -36). Community users corroborate that it 'stays completely out of the way' and that reserved time adjusts as meetings arrive (reclaim-comm-1, reclaim-comm-11). Its automations are limited to fixed, calendar-specific features rather than user-defined automations. missing for 10: a general user-defined automation or rule builder with custom triggers and actions, and automation reaching beyond the calendar domain.
